gbm_population_evidence.quote: Pancreatic Ductal Adenocarcinoma; Gastroesophageal Adenocarcinoma; Glioblastoma Multiforme
Patients with locally advanced unresectable or metastatic PDAC, locally advanced unresectable or metastatic GEA, or recurrent GBM

candidate_evidence.quote: The purpose of the study is to test the safety and dosing of \[177Lu\]Lu-FF58, a radioligand therapy for patients with advanced or metastatic tumors that express proteins known as integrins: alpha-v beta-3 integrin (αvβ3) and alpha-v beta-5 integrin (αvβ5).

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Patients with locally advanced unresectable or metastatic PDAC, locally advanced unresectable or metastatic GEA, or recurrent GBM

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: Time-activity curves (TACs) for the various organs and tumor lesions will be produced as fraction of injected activity per gram of tissue (%IA/g) as a function of time.

role_evidence.quote: Patients will receive 68Ga-FF58 and only patients with tumor uptake of 68Ga-FF58 will receive 177Lu-FF58.

agents.drug_class_hint: investigational lutetium-177 integrin alpha-v beta-3/beta-5 targeted radioligand therapy ([177Lu]Lu-FF58; isotope 177Lu)
agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: radioligand therapy for patients with advanced or metastatic tumors that express proteins known as integrins: alpha-v beta-3 integrin (αvβ3) and alpha-v beta-5 integrin (αvβ5)

role_evidence.quote: In both parts of the study, patients will be screened with a \[68Ga\]Ga-FF58 positron emission tomography (PET)/computed tomography (CT) or PET/magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) scan to assess eligibility for treatment with \[177Lu\]Lu-FF58.

agents.drug_class_hint: gallium-68 integrin-targeted PET imaging agent (diagnostic counterpart of FF58)

biomarkers.biomarker_other: integrin alpha-v beta-3 / alpha-v beta-5 expression assessed by [68Ga]Ga-FF58 PET uptake

source_quote.quote: To be treated with \[177Lu\]Lu-FF58, patients must have at least one measurable lesion that shows \[68Ga\]Ga-FF58 uptake on PET/CT or PET/MRI

flag.reason: Target-expression selection is imaging-based (68Ga-FF58 PET uptake); manual says imaging-only markers are not molecular biomarkers, but this is a theranostic target-expression requirement directly matched to the candidate.

coder_notes: Basket phase 1 radioligand trial (PDAC, GEA, recurrent GBM); GBM named in conditions ('Glioblastoma Multiforme', historical term) and inclusion criteria. Candidate is [177Lu]Lu-FF58 coded by ligand code ff58 per W1; [68Ga]Ga-FF58 listed separately as diagnostic_agent. Tumour PK coded yes because tumour-lesion uptake of 177Lu-FF58 (%IA/g over time, dosimetry) is planned; blood PK also planned. The 68Ga-FF58 uptake requirement for treatment is recorded as a candidate-matched eligibility biomarker but flagged because it is imaging-based.
